Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(terra)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Gråstruktur
gs <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/LandCover/Norway_Grå_Arealer_versjon1/Original/Kart over grå arealer GeoPackage-format/32_25835_graastruktur_gpkg.gpkg", layer = "GraastrukturFlate") |> 
  st_transform(25832)

# Pollinator prediction raster (from Markus)
poll <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/polliland_akershus.tif")

# Invasive species raster (created in neighborhood_analysis_invasive.qmd)
invasive <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/invasive_neighborhood.tif")
```

Explore some potentially suitable polygons- ongoing

```{r echo=FALSE}

# filter by compactness to get rid of areas inside of boligfelt
# and long, strangely-shaped polygons
# filter for 50% grey area, no buildings, and >= 1000 sq. meters
# exclude areas that have no obvious restoration potential
rest_bar_graa <- gs |> 
  mutate(perimeter = as.numeric(st_length(st_boundary(geom))),
         pa_ratio = perimeter / areal_m2,
         compactness = 4 * pi * areal_m2 / (perimeter^2)) |> 
  filter(compactness >= 0.4) |> # this worked better than p-a ratio
  filter(andelgraa >= 50,
         areal_m2 >= 1000,
         andelbygg == 0,
         !okosystemtype_3 %in% c("Road and rail networks and associated land",
                                 "Sports and recreation sites", "Airports",
                                 "Cemeteries", "Parks", "Continuous residential area",
                                 "Continuous commercial and industrial area",
                                 "Discontinuous residential area")) # n = 606
 mapview(rest_bar_graa, zcol = "okosystemtype_3")
```

Export map

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/restaurerbar_graa_areal_v2.gpkg"
st_write(rest_bar_graa, out_gpkg, layer = "restaurerbar_graa_areal")

file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/restaurerbar_graa_areal_v2.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
